author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring freelance artists (character, BG, sprites)
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang. Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam: Character Design & Illustration, Character Sprites, Background & Environment Art, Webtoon / Comic Artwork, Game & Digital Art Assets. Cara Melamar: kirimkan portofolio dan perkenalan singkat ke avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com Subject: Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]. Sertakan jenis artwork, art style, ketersediaan, rate freelance.

author: Anonymous participant
title: Looking for Ganondorf / Zelda comfort and yume art
content: Looking for artist (please READ). I'm looking for artists that can do any of these two options: 1. Typical comfort art (in this case with Ganondorf), where viewer is in 1st sight and the character is looking directly at camera saying sweet things. 2. Pairs, yume. I prefer the Wind Waker version of Ganondorf, but Ocarina/remake/Smash or TotK are fine. PAYING EXCLUSIVELY THROUGH PAYPAL (or vgen, kofi, etc if it accepts paypal). PUT YOUR TAT!!!!!! IF IT'S MORE THAN 2 WEEKS I'M JUST NOT INTERESTED.
